newsitem.title: GREECE: Athens bourse 2nd best among emerging mkts - IFC.
newsitem.headline: Athens bourse 2nd best among emerging mkts - IFC.

text.p: The Athens bourse is the second best performing emerging market with a year-to-date $ return of 37 percent, trailing first-place Turkey which is up 55.4 percent based on IFC investable indices, the IFC said.

"Declining inflation and interest rates, forthcoming privatization plans of OTE and DEP, increased foreign and domestic institutional investors' trading activity along with promising corporate restructuring and earnings growth for 1997 boosted Greek stocks," said the International Finance Corporation (IFC).
The Greek bourse was also the beneficiary of overall positive market sentiment for all European emerging markets, the report said.
"The boom in the Greek market is a result of a general positive sentiment in all European emerging markets," said the IFC.
The IFC investable indices for Hungary, Poland and the Czech Republic posted gains of 26.4 percent, 19.3 percent and 15.2 percent respectively.
